defects.why: The asyncpg DAL / Gemini-embeddings / stale-entry re-scrape bullet ends on 'fresh without manual intervention' with no number, so the screen cannot size the freshness or reliability win next to the 30x and 50%→90% lines above it.

Both bullets are p50/p99 timings from a 90-run batch (fetch 7.3s, search 49ms) with no accuracy, faithfulness, or user-facing outcome — reads as a profiler log, not a tool an NPI engineer would adopt.

Every entry is PE lead-sourcing, search-fund utilities, campaign finance, or financial research; the page never shows document templates, engineering-doc pipelines, or tools shipped to design/application engineers on energy hardware.
